title: Handheld Device Use While Driving
grade_or_penalty: Motor vehicle violation; $200-$400 1st, $400-$600 2nd, $600-$800 3rd and later with 3 points and possible 90-day suspension
key_points: Using a handheld cell phone or texting while driving, except hands-free use and emergencies.
elements: The suspect was driving a moving vehicle on a public road
The suspect used a handheld wireless device (talking, texting or other use) without a hands-free device
No exception applies (such as reporting an emergency)
